profile.summary: mattjohnsonpint is a highly specialized Senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in date/time handling, particularly within the Moment.js ecosystem. Their contributions demonstrate exceptional debugging skills focused on Daylight Saving Time transitions, timezone arithmetic, and JavaScript Date object edge cases. The developer excels at maintaining robust testing suites, improving code quality, and making targeted fixes to complex date/time logic. While their contributions are primarily within Moment.js (pre-ES6), their proficiency in JavaScript's core date functionality and prototype-based patterns suggests broader expertise in JavaScript internals.
